description: Two manual trigger buttons, each with a text field for a name typed in by hand, so the patch says what the button is wired to

params.text: Sends a trigger from that row's output

inputs.text: A trigger here fires that row's output without the button being pressed; either of the row's two EXT jacks will do it

outputs.text: A 10V trigger each time that row's button is pressed or one of its EXT inputs is triggered

notes: Click a display and type to name that button; the name is a label and nothing else, and it is saved with the patch.
